styles.b: Handmade plasticine claymation scene, everything sculpted from smooth modelling clay with soft fingerprint texture, chunky rounded shapes, bright cheerful colours, soft studio light.

pictures.name: swamphen-wait
pictures.prompt: A cute round swamp hen (pukeko) with deep blue-purple feathers, a red beak and red shield above it, long red-orange legs, standing calmly and looking friendly.
